video:video.video:title: Level 0: What is Claude, what is design, and why AI designs all look the same
video:video.video:description: Start from zero: what Claude is, what an app designer does, your first chat, and the one idea this whole course is built on.

video:video.video:title: Level 10: Make your app's rulebook and teach it to Claude
video:video.video:description: Turn a few screenshots into a rulebook (a design-system skill) that Claude follows in every chat — every step, every message to type.

video:video.video:title: Level 25: Make your first real screens
video:video.video:description: Ask for a screen in three simple lines and get every version of it — empty, loading, error and success — in one clickable file.

video:video.video:title: Level 50: Learn to spot what's wrong with a design
video:video.video:description: See a screen like a senior designer does: find the real problems, sort them by importance, fix them exactly — and turn every fix into a rule.

video:video.video:title: Level 75: Check the whole journey and get feedback
video:video.video:description: Make sure screens fit together, find the screens everyone forgets, and run reviews where stakeholders give clear, useful feedback.

video:video.video:title: Level 90: Hand your design to engineers (and share it with your team)
video:video.video:description: Explain your design so engineers build it exactly right, check it after it's built, and get your whole team designing from one rulebook.

video:video.video:title: Level 100: Level 100: build your own design tools
video:video.video:description: Go past screens: build the skills, trackers, dashboards and plugins you and your team wish existed — and turn the best ones into products.
